title: Find the part, then the line
statement: In an evidence task, have students find the part of the text where the evidence lives before they hunt for the exact line.
detail: In the independent task of a built Grade 3 lesson, the second step asks where in the story the clues live, and only then is the matching paragraph found in the text (`downloads/SUPERSEDED — see v2 (table format)_ WITW Lesson 1 learning walkthrough.md`, line 239). The walkthrough's reason is that locating the evidence neighbourhood first keeps the hunt a comprehension act rather than a scan-everything act (line 241); the step came from a review suggestion. It rests on one source, and no outcome was measured.
